constraint: every data operation goes through a stored procedure (constitution III)

intent: Make the generic work center request flow real: designation, job-free request, honest time and detail, truthful card, all through the stored-procedure queue path.

FR-001.title: The work center catalog MUST carry a per-work-center designation saying whether requests raised there are generic

FR-002.title: Only a person holding the permission that governs the work center catalog MUST be able to change that designation

FR-003.title: No work center MUST be generic by built-in list, build configuration or default

FR-004.title: Clearing the designation MUST NOT alter requests already raised

FR-005.title: Selecting a generic work center MUST continue the wizard without an active job

FR-006.title: A generic request MUST offer the same categories and items as a work-order request

FR-007.title: Every answer a work-order request takes from the job MUST be asked of the requester

FR-008.title: A generic request MUST NOT store or display a work order number

FR-009.title: A generic request MUST enter the same queue and board through the same stored-procedure path

FR-010.title: The flow MUST be built in its own projects and leave the work-order flow unchanged

FR-011.title: Abandoning the flow MUST leave nothing in the queue

FR-012.title: An answer step whose owning chunk has not shipped MUST report the source unavailable

FR-013.title: A generic request time MUST be the allotted time configured for its item

FR-014.title: An item with no allotted time MUST produce no estimate

FR-015.title: The flow MUST require a needed-by answer and carry it on card, detail and record

FR-016.title: The flow MUST allow an optional free-text description and carry it wherever needed-by is carried

FR-017.title: The confirmation step MUST list everything about to be raised

FR-018.title: Submitting MUST write the request in one operation

FR-019.title: A generic request MUST record requester, work center, item, answers, time raised and accepted warnings

FR-020.title: The requester identity MUST come from the signed-in session and existing employee verification

FR-021.title: An item whose configuration cannot be read MUST be reported as unavailable

FR-022.title: A generic request MUST draw the generic card layout from spec 015 and no work-order cells

FR-023.title: A generic card identity MUST be its stated value and the requesting work center

FR-024.title: A generic card MUST show category and item wording, needed-by time and description when given

FR-025.title: No generic card MUST draw a blank or placeholder cell

FR-026.title: The detail page MUST add requester, time raised, accepted warnings and history to the card facts

FR-027.title: Fulfilling a generic request MUST use the existing handler flow

FR-028.title: Every value a generic request shows MUST come from a live read, the requester answer or configuration

FR-029.title: Every failure to establish a required value MUST be reported on the step with attempt time and retry

FR-030.title: This chunk MUST delete every Temp artefact of the screens it makes real and leave the build green

decisions.decision: Raise a generic request through IWaitlistRequestService.SubmitAsync
decisions.why: FR-009 requires the same queue and stored-procedure path, and that seam already owns the write, audit, notification and board refresh
decisions.rejected: a second submission service writing sp_waitlist_request_insert itself

decisions.decision: Make active_setup_job_id nullable and add an explicit is_generic column
decisions.why: a null alone is indistinguishable from a missing value, and every read needs a stored answer to which kind a row is
decisions.rejected: inferring the kind from active_setup_job_id IS NULL

decisions.why: note is the handler's own note and answers_json is keyed by declared question, so neither can carry a requester description

decisions.decision: Ask the item's configured answer on the item step
decisions.why: the work-order flow asks the same question in the same place, so both flows answer one item identically
decisions.rejected: a separate answer step on every item

decisions.decision: Report the four externally proved answers as unavailable
decisions.why: FR-012 forbids a text box, an offline list or any substitute
decisions.rejected: hiding those steps, which would understate the submission

decisions.why: this chunk's stated value is a configured answer, and forcing it into the part variant would print a part number no request has
decisions.rejected: reusing the Part variant with an empty cell

decisions.decision: Host the flow through INavigationService via a GenericRequestNavigator
decisions.why: spec 015 left the navigator seam for exactly this, and the pages already resolve their view model from GenericRequestPageServices
decisions.rejected: hosting every step in one page with a ContentControl

decisions.decision: Derive each item's answer kind from its card line 2 template
decisions.why: the catalogue already states what each item has to name, so the flow's shape comes from configuration rather than a second table

decisions.decision: Choose the board's card with a DataTemplateSelector on SampleOrder.IsGeneric
decisions.why: WinUI selects a template per item, and the repository already uses the same control for its per-item cell templates

decisions.decision: The four externally proved answer reads return unavailable rather than being skipped
decisions.why: FR-012 forbids a substitute and a skipped step would understate the review

decisions.rejected: keeping the part step in every order
decisions.decision: The part step is conditional on the item's own card-line declaration
decisions.why: an item that states a configured answer has nothing to put on that page, and an unconditional part step would block every request

decisions.rejected: referencing the application from the wizard
decisions.decision: The generic flow is entered through a launcher seam declared in the wizard's own library
decisions.why: the app implements it, so neither library has to reference the other's screens and no reference cycle is created

decisions.decision: The board picks the card per row with a DataTemplateSelector on the row's stored flag
decisions.why: both kinds must sit in one queue and the flag is a stored fact

decisions.rejected: advancing to the result step and reporting the failure there
decisions.decision: A refused raise keeps the requester on the review with the store's own words
decisions.why: FR-029 requires the failure where it matters with a retry, and a result page would report something the store never produced

specify.summary: Plan for making the generic work centre flow real: queue schema and procedures, the live answer seam, submission through the one write door, the flow hosted over the shell's navigation, and the generic card and detail reachable from the board.
specify.key_finding: Both generic request projects are excluded from the application build and no implementation of IGenericRequestStepData or IGenericRequestNavigator exists, so this chunk is the wiring as much as the feature.

tasks.summary: 44 tasks: setup, queue write path, four user-story phases and polish, laid out in waves.

implement.summary: The generic request flow is real: queue schema and procedures, a live answer seam, a submission through the one write door, the flow hosted over the shell, and the generic card and detail reachable from the board.

approach: Extend the queue schema and the one write procedure with a generic flag, a description and the accepted warnings; implement the answer seam and a submission against the existing waitlist request service; host the flow over INavigationService so the work centre step enters it when the work centre is designated generic; and give the board a template selector so a generic row draws the generic card and its detail page.

T001.did: Referenced both generic request projects from the app and gave the flow library the Settings, Shared and Waitlist.View references its live seam needs

T002.did: Made the queue's job id nullable and added is_generic, description and accepted_warnings_json with their comments and an index

T003.did: Appended p_is_generic, p_description and p_accepted_warnings_json to the insert procedure and wrote the job id through the optional-value idiom

T004.did: Returned is_generic, description and accepted_warnings_json from both request reads, and added the condition and answers columns the get read was missing

T007.did: Carried the generic flag, the description and the accepted warnings on the request draft and the stored request

T008.did: Carried the generic flag, the stated answer, the description and the allotted minutes on the board row

T010.did: Refused a blank job id only when the draft is not generic, sent the three new parameters, and mapped the three new columns onto the stored request

T005.did: Confirmed the read the wizard already uses carries the designation: sp_setup_work_centers_get_all returns is_generic, so no SQL change was needed and the draft read change was reverted

T009.did: Carried the designation on the work-centre detail and the selection item

T011.did: Mapped the catalog row's is_generic onto each work-centre detail and onto the selection item the wizard binds

T012.did: Added the designation tests: a fresh catalog row is not generic, the read the wizard loads projects the flag, and an undesignated shape reports not generic

T013.did: Added the submission result the raise attempt answers with: raised with the request id, or failed with the attempt time and a plain-language message

T014.did: Carried the building, item code, answer, allotment, accepted warnings and raised id on the draft, and made the part step conditional

T015.did: Extended the item option with its code, its configured question and options, its length limits, its allotment and the four answer flags

T016.did: Added the submission to the answer seam, so the one write the feature makes goes through the seam every step already talks to

T017.did: Gated the part step on the item's own proved-part requirement, so an item that states a configured answer never reaches a page with nothing to put on it

T018.did: Implemented the live answer seam: generic work centres from the catalog, the wizard's own categories and items with their configured questions and allotments, the four externally proved answers reporting unavailable, and one submission through the existing request service

T020.did: Let a step prepare before it advances and made the forward action asynchronous, so the summary can raise the request and hold the requester when the write fails

T019.did: Asked the item's configured question on the item step and recorded the answer, the item code and the item's answer requirements on the draft

T021.did: Drew the configured question on the item page as a text box or an option list, with the note that says why the step will not move on

T022.did: Raised the request from the summary step and refused to advance on a failed write, and made the result step report the store's own answer

T023.did: Added the wording the new question, the review rows and the refusal note need

T024.did: Added the navigator that carries the one draft and turns each step into its view model's route, and that opens the flow for a chosen work centre

T025.did: Registered the flow's ten view models, pages, answer seam and navigator, and pointed the generic pages at the host's container once at start-up

T029.did: Recorded the item's configured allotment on the draft as part of the item step, leaving it null when the item configures no time

T026.did: Sent a designated work centre into the generic flow instead of the work-order flow, skipping the job gate only for it and leaving every other work centre unchanged

T030.did: Made the needed-by answer required before the details step can be left, kept the description optional, and recorded both on the draft

T031.did: Showed the requester's answer and the item's configured estimate on the review step, and nothing where no time is configured

T033.did: Gave the card a stated-answer variant and carried the category, the stated value and the description on it

T034.did: Draws the category, the stated answer and the description only when they hold a value, so no cell is ever blank or a placeholder

T035.did: Added the wording the new card cells and the stated-answer kind need

T036.did: Carried the generic facts onto the board row and stopped drawing a work order row for a generic request

T037.did: Added the selector that picks the generic card for a generic row and the work-order card for every other, overriding both overloads

T038.did: Hosted the generic card beside the work-order card in one list through the selector, and gave the generic card the whole surface as its way into the detail

T039.did: Made the detail page take the request as its navigation parameter, so it needs no page key or view model to be routed to

T040.did: Opens one generic request's detail page from its card, adding the requester, the time raised and the history to the card's facts

T027.did: Proved the flow visits six steps for an answer-only item and still reaches the part step for an item that needs a proved part

T041.did: Proved each card variant draws only its own cell including the stated answer, that no cell is ever blank, and that a description adds exactly one cell when written

T028.did: Proved the item step records its configured answer and refuses a too-short one, advances with no answer where the item asks nothing, and reports an unreadable item configuration as unavailable

T032.did: Proved the review lists the answer and the configured time, adds no estimate when none is configured, and keeps the requester on the review when the queue refuses

T006.did: Spliced the changed table and three procedures into the aggregate SQL files and added guarded column adds plus descriptions for the three new columns and the nullable job id

T042.did: Recorded what the generic request foundation added to the queue, the procedures and the descriptions, and why each column exists

T043.did: Ran the existing Temp boundary audit against the application's reference graph, which now includes both generic request projects, and it still passes
